g.text: 59 positive DOC responses · 55 complete width pairs · 2020–2023 · one mapped catchment

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #344f5a

g.text: Primary flow threshold: 20% relative prominence. Width ratio 95% month-block CI: 1.38–1.84.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #344f5a

g.text: No time shift or interpolation is fitted. This measures outlet DOC response; it is not a river travel-speed estimate or a cross-form effect.
